description.p: Quake Champions: Doom Edition is a total-conversion mod that brings Id Software’s hybrid Hero Shooter/Arena FPS to DOOM II, accurately replicating the game’s arsenal and greatly expanding upon both modes of play and the roster of playable Champions. Additionally, QC:DE includes extra content from Unreal Tournament.

ul.li: All weapons from Quake Champions, with faithful firing times for the best transferable experience
PVE weapon upgrades that give each weapon a whole new role
33 champions to play, each with unique active and passive abilities
Play Single-Player, Cooperative, Invasion, Deathmatch, CTF and more!
QCDE Arena PVP single-player campaign in the vein of Quake 3 and Unreal Tournament 99
High-speed movement with Doom strafe-running, Quake strafe-jumping, CPM air control, UT dodges and other techniques
Monster sets to mix and match: Classic Doom, Doom 2016, Quake, Quake 2, Quake 4 and many more from the community
Runs on Q-Zandronum, a fork of Zandronum with enhancements for QC:DE
Older versions are also available for GZDoom (1.9.1 and above), Zandronum (3.0 and above) and Delta Touch
Enhanced Deathmatch bots for both local and public use
QCDEmaps: 70+ QCDE-specific maps, including both original and demakes from QC, Q3, Q4, QL, Doom 2016, UT and more!
Weapon skins from every Quake game, Half-Life and Serious Sam
Optional soundtrack by Michael Markie with original songs and covers of well-known favorites
Optional add-ons with Unreal Tournament weapons, movement and soundtrack
Damage numbers, speedometer, in-game champion info screens, and tons of customization with very sane defaults
Lootboxes! For free!
And more!
~~~ General ~~~

Added "Modded" weapons skin option. The option provides players an ability to create and install weapon skin addons that replace weapon graphics, sounds and visual effects remain compatible with servers and players who don’t have the addon. Modded addons are entirely clientside and people who don't have them will see QCDE 1.0 skins instead.
Added "sv_bfgrespawn" cvar to control BFG respawn timer.
Added "cl_qchandicap" cvar to handicap your own damage. Accepted values are from 50 to 100 in multiples of 5.
~~~ Gameplay and balance ~~~
Orbb drone now explodes with damage on every cause of death, including timeout.
Gave Freeman Quake World movement. Best air strafing from A-D buttons, tiny forward air acceleration, tiny strafe jump acceleration, no air strafing when holding W.

Gave Brock a Translocator ability. The primary fire launches a module that flies forward, is affected by gravity and bounces off walls. Alt fire then lets Brock teleport to the module. Using primary fire when a module is already deployed will return it back. The module can be destroyed with a single hit. Teleporting to it in that case will kill Brock instantly. Brock has 3 Translocator charges that are not affected by hourglass pickups, instead the charges refill after 5 seconds.
* Brock Translocator can't telefrag, but instead it retains momentum when teleport succeeds. That lets Brock perform movement tricks by dashing or using a jumppad before using a translocator.
* Brock can't teleport to Translocator module while holding a flag, but can still fire the module.
Brock no longer picks up Small and Heavy Armor in PvE if it is maxed out.
Duke Nuken and Sam no longer can start firing their ability weapons while holding a flag, but can keep firing if they started before picking up the flag.
Gave Bitterman in UT movement a Boost Dodge passive ability that makes his wall dodge higher when holding the jump button.
UT Redeemer explosion damage now gradually grows in size instead of being one huge explosion.
Reduced duration the player camera is held hostage after exploding a controlled UT Redeemer rocket.
~~~ Maps ~~~
Added QCDL14 Akuse, based on CPM3 from CPMA.
Added QCDL15 Takken Apart, based on Dismemberment from Quake Live.
Added QCTF05 Blood Crossings, based on Blood Covenant CTF map from Quake Champions.
Added QCTF06 CTF-Face, based on Facing Worlds CTF maps from Unreal Tournament series and the Unreal Tournament Secret Level episode.
Replaced QCDE20 Deck with Crossfire, based on Crossfire map from Half-Life.
Added normal gravity on QCME02 (Morpheus) indoor areas.
Increased spawn points count to 8 on QCDE15 Chastity Belt, QCDE30 Gibel Complex and QCDE44 Exile.
Changed DM Campaign Hub portal frame textures, to make it easier to understand the gamemode behind that portal.
Added "PrintSongName (str musicName, str musicAuthor)" ACS script for mappers to print their custom music names in QC:DE style.
~~~ Graphics and Sound ~~~
Added alternative frag and hit beeps, you can configure them in Settings in Sound tab.
Updated and added multiple voxels models.
Implemented weapon skins to UT weapons.
Changed default UT Sniper Rifle skin to that from Unreal Championship 2.
Updated some UT HUD and item pickup graphics and voxel models.
Reduced resolution of Kane sprites to be consistent with other characters.
Updated all Corvus game sounds and taunts.
Releveled Brock sounds and taunts.
Made Keel alternate between left and right grenade launchers.
Refreshed most weapon skins, especially the Quake 3 ones.
Refreshed weapons pickup sprites.
Updated keycard and DM Hub keys sprites.
Updated DM Campaign portal frame textures.
Updated Q1 RG and Tri-Bolt sounds
Replaced QCDL11 midi music track because it gets recognized by YouTube and blocked in some countries.
Replaced current UT music addon with a new addon by Pepperperson.
~~~ Menus ~~~
Fixed incorrect texts in defrag maps menu.
Fixed defrag skirmish menu options.
~~~Bugfixes~~~
Fixed missing intermission in Doom 1 episode 1.
Fixed Heavy Armor not giving Brock armor above 150 points in PvE when extra armor bonus is aquired.
Fixed Duke Nukem ability kill obituaries.
Fixed BFG firing continuously when holding alt fire button.
Fixed upgrade graphics in lootboxes.
Fixed dead marine Kane decoration sprites.
Fixed a crash caused by Sanic bot on linux servers.
Fixed rockets causing too much knockback on enemies.
Fixed Orbb sideways speed when pressing crouch button.
Fixed invisible Nyx playing double jump sounds in UT movement addon.
Fixed starter weapons not switching to dropped upgraded weapons automatically.
Reverted the quake explosion thrust formula when hit by other players.
Fixed Zedek and Postal ability graphics.
Changed Kane ability screen blend from blue to orange.
Added automap markers for weapons and powerups in PvP.
The explosion knockback on players is calculated relative to their eyes, no matter who fired the projectile. Previously, it only worked when receiving knockback from own projectiles.
"callvote" command now also automatically votes "yes".
Made rocket/nail boosts on high ping slightly less jittery.
Added bot variations from Combalance addon.
Updated bots AI. They can now chase the player sometimes. Also they can now follow the player in PvE.
Increased Doom Movement champions ground speed.
Orbb drone is now solid, so it can block other players, and can be used as an air platform to navigate the map.
Orbb drone now has 100 health and can be destroyed.
Pressing attack button while controlling Orbb drone turns it into a controllable missile that rushes forward and explodes on impact.
Increased Orbb drone explosion damage in PvP from 85 to 100.
Increased Orbb overbounce retain velocity from 82% to 85%.
Grayson ability no longer freezes players movement.
Galen totems heal refill in PvP when a new totem is thrown.
Reduced Galen ability PvP cooldown from 35 to 30 seconds.
Corvus flight now only boosts speed by 16% instead of 42%.
Corvus now receives 25% more damage when in flight.
Menelkir's Maulotaur no longer does the ground flame attack.
Menelkir's Maulotaur is now more aggressive. He moves faster and charges into enemies if they are nearby.
Enemies killed by Menelkir or Maulotaur now prolong Maulotaur's life.
Nerfed Ranger orb damage in PvP.
Ranger can't teleport for a short while after throwing the orb.
Doomslayer BFG fires faster in PvP.
Reduced Doomslayer ability cooldown in PvP to 40 seconds.
Increased Painkiller demon form speed.
Increased Painkiller demon form projectile speed in PvP.
Painkiller can now cancel his demon form immediately by pressing active ability button.
Zedek stomp deals less damage, but launches enemies upward.
Lucienne now drops her immolation ball in PvE when falling to 30 hp instead of on death. To recharge the passive, heal back to 100 hp.
Reduced Kane crouch slide speed and Injection speed boost.
Reduced Durandal and Intruder air acceleration.
Removed speed cap from CPM champions in PvE.
Reduced Shotgun bullet spread.
Nailgun ammo pickups give 50 nails.
UT Dispersion Pistol upgrades no longer reduce fire rate.
Changed Kane sprites to a stroggified variant.
Updated all Quake 4 weapon skin sprites.
Updated all Quake Wars: Enemy Territory weapon skin sprites, except SNG.
Updated Quake 3 HMG, SNG and BFG skin sprites.
Updated Quake 2 Gauntlet, Nailgun, LG and BFG skin sprites.
Updates Serious Sam MG, SNG, LG, RG and BFG skin sprites.
Added Quake Live HMG as the Quake 3 Machinegun skin.
Added Quake 3 Team Arena nailgun as the Quake 3 Shotgun skin.
Updated green BFG projectile sprites.
Updated graphics for Default BFG, Half-Life HMG, Half-Life BFG and Serious Sam BFG skins.
Updated graphics for hourglasses, automap pickup, rad suit pickup, protection powerup.
Updated graphics for all weapon upgrades.
Updated scope graphics for Quake 4, Quake World and Serious Sam Railgun skin scopes.
Updated weapons HUD sprites.
Added fire sprites to Painkiller gauntlet when upgraded in PvE.
Added HUD graphics for Painkiller gauntlet.
Updated Postal smoke sprites.
Updated Zedek flame sprites.
Picked more suitable weapon skins for sets that lack skins in some slots when using class based skins.
Updated ability graphics for Bitterman, DoomSlayer, Galen, Grayson, Kane, Keel, Lucienne, Major.
Updated cursor graphic. You can select the old cursor in settings if you wish.
Redone all UT weapons sprites.
Fixed wrong menu scaling on resolutions other than 1920x1080. Now all menu elements should be properly visible on all screens.
Fixed issue when Galen totems won't play heal sound in multiplayer sometimes.
All changes since 2.7 are documented in the included changelog
